**Shipped:** v31.07 `cw-sticks`. The how-to-play controller keycaps now read "left stick" and "right stick" instead of "l stick" and "r stick". Preflight passed and the gate passed, with fingerprint 85/374 and 165/593.

| Screen | Score | Note |
|---|---|---|
| 46 how to play | 3, same as before | Still asks for a filled "got it" button. That contradicts the any-key prompt on the arcade cabinet, which closes on any key, so I skipped it. |
| 47 drop controls card | not captured | The critic output was cut off, so I don't have its score. The picture is the live raid HUD, not a party card. |
| 53 extracted / bonus / initials | 2 | The picture is a mid-extract raid HUD, not an end card. |
| 58 player 2 window title | 3, better than before | It wants the amber title made flat. I left the wordmark colour alone because it is his art. |

I did not re-run the critic on 48, 49, 52, 54, 55, 56, 62, 63 or 64. All 13 screens were re-shot into `shots/12d-after`.

**Why I stopped:**
- **47 and 53:** the staging is in `ui-screens-js.json`, which I can't edit. The HUD itself belongs to another task, so I changed nothing.
- **Footer prompt:** the critic keeps flipping on it, so nothing safe is left to ship. I did not add this to `questions.md`.
- **Stat columns on 52 and 55:** these already have equal stat columns, so that planned item was already done.

I logged the change in `notes\ui\changes.md` and in the Changes section of `notes\ui\index.html`. My notes are in `notes\12-ui-party-screens.md`.
